The card for a task made ready and done must close (reviewer saw 'Retry ladder exhausted' for Quote page stay open after the task was done).
'Mark done anyway' (Inbox card only, ADR 0102 decision 2) writes a reason containing 'accepted without review' so the task display reads 'Done: accepted without review'.
A person task ('Me: ask me in the Inbox', specialist 'person') must offer only Answer and Cancel, never 'Go ahead without' (no specialist exists).

Withdrawn cards: a person's task move withdraws its open cards (status withdrawn). An Inbox Answered/history list can show them as 'withdrawn: you moved the task', and after Undo the card comes back open (HumanRequestRepo.reopenWithdrawn).

POST /changes/:id/undo (server.ts) emits no 'inbox' event after an undo, so the header's Inbox count stays stale after an Undo on the Changes page. Add rt.events.emit('inbox', {}) after rt.commands.undo, with a test.

Typing 'stop' in Chat freezes the agent (session.stop with the agent scope: Stop all, the stopped bar until 'Allow sessions again'). Design §3.9: chat 'stop' / 'stop after this task' means the running session: send a session-scoped stop (Stop now) or POST /sessions/:id/pause (Stop after this task); only an explicit 'stop everything' / kill switch freezes. Whose-stop classification follows (one session is 'you').

The chat's command replies are also posted to the Inbox (executor.ts). needs-me owns removing that Inbox echo; your reply in the chat itself must read plainly (no '(1 run, 0 processes)', no 'Undo.' suffix).

decisions.reason: Owner's choice: stacked PRs (a dependent task's branch and PR base on its dependency's branch), or merge the dependencies' unmerged branches into the task's branch (the critic's diff then needs the same base), or hold a dependent task until its dependency's PR is merged.
decisions.owner_question: In a repository project, a task whose dependency's pull request is not merged yet: base its branch and PR on the dependency's branch (stacked PRs), merge the dependencies' unmerged branches into its branch, or hold it until the dependency's PR is merged?
decisions.decided: Merge the dependencies' unmerged task branches into the dependent task's branch before it starts (its PR still targets the default branch, so the person can merge in any order); the PR body names the PRs whose work it includes until they are merged; the critic's diff and the changed-file list are the task's own commits (against the merge base that includes the dependencies), not the dependencies' work. A merge conflict between dependencies is a card for the person, never a silent drop.

stops.problem: Quitting Forerunner while the critic reviews a task leaves the task 'Being reviewed' for good after reopening.
stops.evidence: Garden club Contact: quit at 14:08:16 during 'Being reviewed'; after the restart the row and drawer read 'Being reviewed · The critic is checking the work.' with Cancel only (52, 60). The Start dialog does not list it (59). The Update says 'Your last session was interrupted when Forerunner closed. Nothing was left half done.' (53). daemon.log: '[session-recovery] interrupted sessions ended at start {"tasks":[]}'. Likely cause: recovery.ts releases only tasks the agent still claims, and the graceful quit had released the claim with the status left at in_review. (live report: /tmp/frbench/live-reports/phaseC-*.md; screenshots /tmp/frbench/livec-a/steps and /tmp/frbench/livec-b/steps)

Root-cause it on the bench: quit (the daemon's graceful shutdown) during a review, start again; recovery must return an in_review task with no live review to Ready (and say so in the Update), whether or not a claim is still held. Test across a real restart (validation rule 4).
